root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph Runtime Wrapper
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase lacks a reproducible and verifiable integration with the Infigraph CLI. There is no code path or wrapper that can resolve the pinned CLI, verify its execution, and define standard capability/status contracts.
root_causes.solution_summary: Implement a new `infigraph_runtime.py` wrapper that performs reproducible execution using pinned metadata, and handles capability discovery, exposing normalized statuses.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
